name: Bagua mirror
look: Bagua mirror, a protective treasure from cultivation fantasy. A large octagonal bronze mirror ringed with the eight trigram bars floats in front of the character, its polished face glowing pale jade, turning slowly.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the octagonal bronze mirror alone, facing front, its trigram bars and glowing jade face, no glow round it
forms: turned a quarter away, narrower, its face foreshortened
seen edge-on, a thin bronze bar
shrunk to a small bright point of jade light

parts.name: TRIGRAM
parts.text: one trigram bar alone, large and upright, its three lines clear

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: jade sparks, a ripple ring seen flat, a crack line

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the mirror's jade face, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the mirror spins up out of a point of light in front of the character and grows to full size
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the mirror floats and turns slowly, the trigram bars lighting one after another; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the mirror's face from the right; the face flashes white and the blow is thrown back to the right as a straight beam of light

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the mirror spins faster, shrinks to a point and winks out
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
